local_articles.title: Kalshi hits the back of the net with $27 billion FIFA World Cup windfall
local_articles.snippet: July 23 - Prediction market startup Kalshi scored well during the 2026 FIFA World Cup, netting roughly double its projected user traffic and trading volume as fans scrambled to turn their soccer savvy into profits. Kalshi recorded $27 billion in trading volume and saw about 3 million users during the length of the tournament, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters on Thursday. The competition ran its expanded 48-team format this year and became the most lucrative in FIFA's history. The source said the startup had expected $13 billion in volume and about 1.5 million users during the tournament, which opened at Estadio Azteca in Mexico and ended in New Jersey, where Spain beat Lionel Messi's defending champions Argentina to lift the trophy for a second time. questions.title: Which country will win the men's team gymnastics gold medal at the 2026 Commonwealth Games?
questions.background: The Commonwealth Games men's team gymnastics competition awards medals according to the final team standings.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official Commonwealth Games results, corroborated by contemporary reliable news reporting. Resolution Condition : Resolve to the country awarded gold in the men's team gymnastics competition at the 2026 Commonwealth Games, once the final standings are announced. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the winning country.
questions.current_reasoning: Major 2026-07-21 roster correction from The Gymternet's July 20 Glasgow 2026 complete athlete roster guide and Gymnastics Canada's July 20 official release: contrary to our earlier assumption that Team England was fielding Olympic/world A-team stars like Jake Jarman and Joe Fraser, England's actual Glasgow 2026 men's squad is Joshua Nathan, Adam Tobin, Luke Whitehouse, Alexander Yolshin-Cash, and Max Whitlock (who withdrew on July 13 with a hand injury, requiring a reserve replacement)—meaning NONE of Paris 2024 Olympians Jake Jarman, Joe Fraser, or Harry Hepworth (nor Courtney Tulloch or James Hall) are competing. By contrast, Gymnastics Canada confirmed on July 20 its full-strength Paris 2024 Olympic core—Félix Dolci, René Cournoyer, and William Émard—alongside Jordan Carroll and Ethan Ikeda, fresh off winning 2026 Pan American Championships team gold (with Émard winning rings gold and Carroll pommel horse silver). Under 5-4-3 scoring in Friday July 24's Subdivision 3 final, Canada holds a clear apparatus advantage across rings, vault, parallel bars, and high bar against England's depleted B-squad, flipping Canada sharply 0.25 -> 0.56 and cutting England 0.64 -> 0.31 (retaining 31% for England given GB depth led by 3x European floor champion Luke Whitehouse and former British AA champion Joshua Nathan, near-home UK support, 5-4-3 fall variance, and unverified Whitlock replacement). Holding Australia at 0.05 (Jesse Moore plus 4 debutants) and nudging Cyprus (0.03 -> 0.04, led by 2024 European AA champion Marios Georgiou) and host Scotland (0.02 -> 0.03, Hamish Carter and Pavel Karnejenko) slightly higher on England's weakened lineup (1% residual).

questions.title: What type of munition will be confirmed destroyed in Syria's first OPCW-verified chemical-weapons destruction operation since 2014?
questions.background: The Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons (OPCW) verifies the destruction of chemical weapons and associated munitions.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the type of munition identified as destroyed in Syria's first OPCW-verified chemical-munitions destruction operation since 2014, as reported to the UN Security Council by 2026-09-03. Resolution Date : 2026-09-03 Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the specific munition type, excluding its quantity.
questions.current_reasoning: Major OPCW development on 2026-07-09: at its 112th session, the OPCW Executive Council reinstated Syria's voting rights and formally approved a detailed verification plan for the destruction of Category 3 chemical weapons at Al Qutayfah (37 km north of Damascus), alongside facility agreements for the Al Qutayfah and Homs CW storage sites (OPCW press release, AP News July 9). Under the CWC, Category 3 strictly denotes unfilled military chemical munitions and devices—effectively excluding improvised industrial chlorine cylinders (0.06 -> removed) from this first operation and concentrating probability on the two unfilled Assad-era binary munition types highlighted in OPCW's May 27 discovery report: aerial bombs of the Ltamenah/Khan Shaykhun type (0.38 -> 0.42) and rockets of the Ghouta type (0.32 -> 0.34). Artillery shells hold at 0.07, unfilled missile warheads enter at 0.05 reflecting Al Qutayfah's historical missile/CW depot role and Syria's prior Category 3 inventory, mortar shells edge to 0.04, and 8% tail mass covers other specific Category 3 designations or devices.

questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official club or player announcement, or reliable contemporaneous sports reporting confirming a completed move. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the first club Vozinha joins after leaving Chaves in 2026. Offers, negotiations, and proposed transfers do not count. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the club.

I hope to find a team that really wants me as a player, not as a marketing person'), and Inter Miami signed Casemiro on July 22 amid an MLS tampering probe; although Lionel Messi's reported gesture buying World Cup final tickets for Vozinha's family keeps a faint personal link alive, Inter Miami drops sharply (0.09 -> 0.04).
